note: M25.1 (ADR 0039). Talk topics: what NPCs say on the first talk of the day. Texts are our own words. kind news/rumor/request; 'request' is a hint to a game feature, not canon. Gate: who (npcs/tags/towns, any), flags, not_flags, days [from,to].

b1.rock_crabs.text: Do not walk the floodplains alone. Rock Crabs sit in the grass like boulders until you step too close.

b1.goblins_on_the_plains.text: Goblins roam the hills around the city. Keep to the road and do not carry food in the open.

b1.inn_reopened.text: Someone opened the old inn on the hill. A Human, they say, and she serves pasta.

b1.necromancer_wanted.text: The Watch wants a Human [Necromancer] in a dirty robe. Tell a guard if you see him.

b1.chess_in_the_market.text: The Human from the inn beat Olesm at chess, right there in the market.

b1.ruins_found.text: Ruins were found under the plains. Adventurers come from all over to dig in them.

b1.ruins_monsters.text: Things crawl out of the ruins at night. Stay well away from the dig.

b1.horns_lost.text: The Horns of Hammerad went into the ruins and did not come back.

b1.runner_leg.text: The barefoot City Runner broke her leg in the street. Nobody will say who did it.
b1.runner_leg.note: What Celum gossip says is a guess; the attack itself is canon.

b1.magnolia_busy_runners.text: Lady Reinhart keeps every Runner in the guild busy with her deliveries.

b2.winter.text: Winter is here. Frost Fairies ride the wind now. Do not annoy them.

hint.parcels.text: The Runners' Guild pins parcels on its request board. A few coppers each, if you have the legs.
hint.parcels.note: Points to deliver_parcel at the request boards.

hint.spellbooks.text: The Mages' Guild sells spellbooks off its shelf. Not cheap, but you learn the spell.

hint.smithy.text: Want a real weapon? The smithy in Liscor sells them. Better than a kitchen knife.

hint.krshia_stall.text: Buy from my stall, yes? Fair prices, not like some Drakes.

hint.inn_help.text: Erin could use another pair of hands at the inn. She feeds the people who work for her.
hint.inn_help.note: Points to the inn work actions (rules.economy.hunger).

hint.hunting.text: Fresh meat sells in the market. A hunter with a bow does well on the plains.
hint.hunting.note: Points to the hunt and shoot_bow actions.
